name: Shakti Pumps India Ltd
title: Shakti Pumps India Ltd-$ - 531431 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR 2,698 cr but EBITDA margin fell to ~16% (management cites ~10% in Q4) and receivables are still INR 1,276 cr; no FY27 numbers given.

capex.quote: we will also get the capacity of 0.5 GW from Q2FY27 onwards and the 2.2 GW solar cell capacity, we are looking at March’28.

triggers.label: Magel Tyala realisation down 3-4%
triggers.quote: the recent tenders we have received have had an impact of 3% to 4%

triggers.label: Competition up, prices affected
triggers.quote: yes, our competition has increased and because of that the price also gets affected a bit

triggers.label: Receivables cut INR 420 cr in Q4
triggers.quote: Receivables were reduced by over INR 420 crores during the fourth quarter

triggers.label: Left INR 200 cr Maharashtra orders
triggers.quote: we left orders of INR 200 crores in Maharashtra, since we were not getting any clarity on payments

triggers.label: No FY27 numeric guidance
triggers.quote: We are not guiding on any number at the moment.

guidance.quote: Once the geopolitical situation settles, then we will communicate. We will update you in Q1FY27.
We are expecting that we will have the expanded capacity in pumps from Q2FY27 onwards.
we are seeing 15% margins at the EBITDA level for this business
We are not guiding on any number at the moment.

red_flags.label: Margin collapse 24% to ~10%
red_flags.quote: the margins this year have been affected by increased raw material pricing

red_flags.label: Receivables INR 1,276 cr, 916 not due
red_flags.quote: out of INR 1,276 crores, INR 916 crores is not due

red_flags.label: Repeated evasion on guidance and margin
red_flags.quote: It will be a little early to comment on a number right now.

red_flags.label: Tender pricing set at L1
red_flags.quote: we have done business under the L1 criteria

evasions.quote: It will be a little early to comment on a number right now.
We are not guiding on any number at the moment.
We cannot discuss the rates on this call.
We will share these details with you separately.
